versions.content: {DRAFT} If DataTransformationStatusForwarding is set to no TransformerStatusForwarding and PXX is P01 ,P02 ,P04 ,P05 ,P06 ,P07 ,P08 ,P11 ,P22 or P44, the function E2EXf_<transformerId>() shall invoke E2E_PXXProtect(), passing to that function the appropriate Config and State structures (see [SWS_ E2EXf_00125] and [SWS_E2EXf_00126]) that are associated with <transformerId>, as well as buffer and bufferLength (only for P04, P05, P06, P07, P08 ,P11 ,P22 and P44) that were updated in above requirements SWS_E2EXf_00108, SWS_E2EXf_00109, SWS_E2EXf_00115, SWS_E2EXf_00111.
